name: family-education-expert
description:
This is the SINGLE MAIN entry skill for ALL parent conversations. It implements the unified
three-stage flow defined in prompts/system_prompt.md §0.5:
Stage A (rounds 1-3): gather info + lock ONE main issue.
Stage B (end of round 3): triage simple vs complex.
Stage C-Light: reframe + cite a camp case + offer one tool + give one tonight-action.
Stage C-Heavy: hand over to res-family-intervention long-term mode.
Listening / case-diagnosis / methodology-QA are NOT separate skills anymore — they are
internalized as three "modes" within this single main flow.
